content.description: Two photographs show flat rectangular items in shades of grey laid on a light beige background. The first photograph shows three items stacked in light grey, dark grey and mid grey. The second photograph shows two items in dark grey and mid grey. The photographs do not show enough detail to identify the product type, construction, material or any labels. No tags, size labels or care labels are visible. A printed card in the first photograph contains printed instructions and claims; these are not reflected in this listing. Product type, condition, material and sizing are to be confirmed against the brand's manifest.
